title: Obligation and advice
grammar: Must, Have to, Should, Must not, Do not have to

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn how to express obligation, prohibition and advice using must, have to, should and their negatives.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. You must wear a seatbelt. I have to work on Saturday. You should see a doctor. You must not smoke here. You do not have to come. Notice: must = personal obligation, have to = external rule, should = advice, must not = prohibition, do not have to = no obligation.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: You ___ smoke in the hospital. It is forbidden.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 pieces of advice for someone visiting your country for the first time.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: I ___ go to work tomorrow. It is a holiday.
phases.explanation: Do not have to means no obligation.
